name: voice-split-v2
what: Every voice (dataset + speaker) with a usable clip, the one clip it uses, and its split.

rules.voice: a speaker with at least one neutral clip of 3-25 s of speech (VCTK: mic mic1, silent clips left out)
rules.clip: the voice's longest usable clip; on a tie, the first clip id
rules.split: by voice, each dataset on its own, 80 % validation and 20 % test (rounded, at least 1), shuffled with seed 42
rules.test: locked: unused until the final evaluation
